cohort: 75 pregnant women (aged 20-35 years) taking warfarin for prosthetic valve replacement
finding: Miscarriages, cesarean sections, low birth weight, and prematurity were more common in patients receiving warfarin >5 mg.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were more common in patients receiving warfarin >5 mg.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more common in patients receiving warfarin >5 mg.
